verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Zulip supports *incoming* webhooks for pushing external events into Zulip (zulip-docs-19) and a bot framework for reacting to messages (zulip-docs-4/12/24), but nothing documents an outgoing webhook mechanism for an AI-native user to subscribe to Zulip's own events. missing for 10: documentation of outgoing/subscription webhooks, event-type configuration, or webhook payload schema for external consumers.
